{\colortbl ;\red0\green0\blue0;}
\viewkind4\uc1\pard\lang1044\f0\fs20 MODEL W1RELAY87L
\par COMMENT
\par Differential current relay, with h'th harmonic restraint,
\par by Kine Wold 2014 and partly Torstein Stadheim 2012.
\par Source: 
\par [1]Current Differential Line Protection Setting Considerations,
\par by S. Ward and T. Erwin, RFL Electronics Inc, 2005.
\par [2]Practical Experience in Setting Transformer Differential Inrush Restraint,
\par by R. Hunt, J. Scaefer and B. Bentert, 2007
\par [3]A New Approach to Current Differential Protection for Transmission Lines,
\par by M.G. Adamiak, G.E. Alexander, Dr. W. Premerlani, GE digital energy
\par The current I1 and I2 is defined as current entering  the protected area or componenent.
\par The calculations is based on equation 3,4 in[1]. The 2nd harmonic option was found in [2].
\par The source data(current) should be in rectangular form.
\par The restraint area is divided in two parts to aim at a combination of a percentage restraint and variabel restraint.
\par 3-phase model and transformer phase shift by HK. H\'f8idalen, 2014
\par ENDCOMMENT
\par 
\par DATA
\par   K1                -- Restraint area constant, slope of first restraint area  [pu]
\par   K2                -- Restraint area constant, slope of second restraint area  [pu]
\par   i_start           -- Restraint area constant, differential current start of first area [A]
\par   i_step2           -- Restraint area constant, restraint current start of second area [A]
\par   t_delay           -- Trip delay[s]
\par   k                 -- Restraint current scalar
\par   comm_delay        -- assumed time delay caused by communication channel [s]
\par   FREQ \{dflt:50\}    -- fundamental frequency of circuit in [Hz]
\par   h_res \{dflt:20\}   -- h'th harmonic restraint, in percent of first harmonic magnitude [%]
\par   DownSampl \{dflt:1\}-- Record only every downsamples value
\par   t_init \{dflt:0.02\}-- time before relay can operate in seconds
\par   Idx               -- Unique identifier (managed by ATPDraw)
\par INPUT 
\par   i1re_1[1..3]      -- First harmonic real part
\par   i1im_1[1..3]      -- First harmonic imaginary part
\par   i1re_h[1..3]      -- Harmonic h real part, for inrush blocking. Typical 2nd harmonic.
\par   i1im_h[1..3]      -- Harmonic h imaginary part
\par   i2re_1[1..3]      -- First harmonic real part
\par   i2im_1[1..3]      -- First harmonic imaginary part
\par   i2re_h[1..3]      -- Harmonic h real part
\par   i2im_h[1..3]      -- Harmonic h imaginary part
\par   Block \{dflt:0\}    -- Block signal true or 1 = Block 
\par OUTPUT 
\par   Trip
\par   Zone[1..3]
\par VAR
\par   trip
\par   i_diff[1..3]    -- First harmonic differential current
\par   i_diff_h        -- h'th harmonic differential current
\par   i_rest[1..3]     -- Restraint current(first harmonic)
\par   deltaT[1..3]    -- Elapsed time from fault detection
\par   i_limit1        -- For restraint calculation
\par   i_limit2        -- For restraint calculation
\par   ratioh          -- Ratio of h'th harmonic to first harmonic magnitude
\par   zone[1..3]      -- Which zone (0 or 1 here) tripped in phase 1..3 as function of time 
\par   i,d,a1,f1,i1re1[1..3],i1im1[1..3],a2,f2,i1reh,i1imh,angle
\par INIT
\par   zone[1..3]:=0
\par   deltaT[1..3]:=0
\par   angle:= comm_delay*2*PI*FREQ  -- to account for communications delay
\par   d:=0
\par   trip:=1
\par ENDINIT
\par EXEC
\par   if (t>t_init ) AND (Block=FALSE)
\par   then
\par     for i:=1 to 3 do
\par       a1:=sqrt(i1re_1[i]**2+i1im_1[i]**2)
\par       if i1im_1[i]=0 AND i1re_1[i]=0
\par       then
\par         f1:=0
\par       else
\par         f1:=atan2(i1im_1[i],i1re_1[i])
\par       endif
\par       i1re1[i]:=a1*cos(f1-angle)
\par       i1im1[i]:=a1*sin(f1-angle)
\par       a2:=sqrt(i1re_h[i]**2+i1im_h[i]**2)
\par       if i1im_h[i]=0 AND i1re_h[i]=0
\par       then
\par         f2:=0
\par       else
\par         f2:=atan2(i1im_h[i],i1re_h[i])
\par       endif
\par       i1reh:=a2*cos(f2-angle)
\par       i1imh:=a2*sin(f2-angle)
\par       -- Calculates differential and restraint currents
\par       i_diff[i]:=sqrt((i1re1[i]+i2re_1[i])**2+(i1im1[i]+i2im_1[i])**2)
\par       i_diff_h:=sqrt((i1reh+i2re_h[i])**2+(i1imh+i2im_h[i])**2)
\par       i_rest[i]:=k*(sqrt(i1re1[i]**2+i1im1[i]**2)+sqrt(i2re_1[i]**2+i2im_1[i]**2))
\par       ratioh := 100 * i_diff_h * recip(i_diff[i]) --1st to h'th harmonic ratio
\par       if ratioh < h_res  
\par       then          -- no h'th harmonic blocking
\par         if (i_rest[i] < i_step2) 
\par         then        -- REGION 1
\par           i_limit1:= i_start+ K1*i_rest[i]
\par           if i_diff[i] > i_limit1 
\par           then
\par             deltaT[i]:= deltaT[i] + timestep
\par             if deltaT[i] > t_delay 
\par             then 
\par               zone[i]:= 1
\par             endif
\par           else      -- RESET
\par             deltaT[i]:= 0 
\par             zone[i]:= 0
\par           endif
\par         else        -- REGION 2
\par           i_limit2:= i_start + K2*i_rest[i]- (K2 - K1)*i_step2
\par           if i_diff[i] > i_limit2 
\par           then
\par             deltaT[i]:= deltaT[i] + timestep
\par             if deltaT[i] > t_delay 
\par             then
\par               zone[i]:= 1
\par             endif
\par           else      -- RESET
\par             deltaT[i]:= 0
\par             zone[i]:= 0
\par           endif
\par         endif       -- zone testing
\par       endif         -- no h'th blocking
\par     endfor
\par     trip:=not OR(zone[1],zone[2],zone[3],not trip); 
\par     if (d mod DownSampl) =0
\par     then
\par       write('BEGIN WRITE @W1RELAY87L',round(Idx))          --Do not modify this line, replaced by ATPDraw
\par       write(i_rest[1],i_diff[1],i_rest[2],i_diff[2],i_rest[3],i_diff[3],trip,T) 
\par       write('END WRITE @W1RELAY87L',round(Idx))            --Do not modify this line, replaced by ATPDraw
\par     endif 
\par     d:=d+1
\par   endif -- t>t_init 
\par ENDEXEC
\par ENDMODEL\cf1\b 
\par }
</helpstring>

        <helpstring>{\rtf1\ansi\deff0{\fonttbl{\f0\fnil\fcharset0 Courier New;}}
\viewkind4\uc1\pard\lang1044\f0\fs20 MODEL WMeter
\par comment-----------------------------------------------
\par Calculate active power of each phase and the total sum.
\par SYM is symmetry flag. Default SYM=2. 
\par Set SYM=1 for one period stabilization.
\par --------------------------------------------endcomment
\par INPUT U[1..3],I[1..3]
\par DATA FREQ, SYM
\par OUTPUT AP[1..3],APOW
\par VAR APOW,power,pow[1..3], e[1..3],ap[1..3]
\par DELAY CELLS (e[1..3]):(trunc(recip(FREQ*timestep*SYM))+1)
\par 
\par HISTORY INTEGRAL(pow[1..3]) \{DFLT:0\}
\par HISTORY e[1..3] \{DFLT:0\}
\par 
\par EXEC
\par   FOR n:=1 TO 3 DO  
\par     pow[n]:=U[n]*I[n]
\par 
\par     e[n]:=INTEGRAL(pow[n])
\par     IF t>=recip(FREQ*SYM)  -- Output after T/SYM
\par     THEN  
\par       AP[n]:=(e[n]-delay(e[n],recip(FREQ*SYM),0))*FREQ*SYM
\par     ELSE
\par       AP[n]:=0
\par     ENDIF
\par   ENDFOR
\par   power:=(pow[1]+pow[2]+pow[3])  --instantaneous active power
\par   APOW:=AP[1]+AP[2]+AP[3]
\par ENDEXEC
\par ENDMODEL
\par 
\par 
\par }
</helpstring>
        <datastring>MODEL WMetercomment-----------------------------------------------Calculate active power of each phase and the total sum.SYM is symmetry flag. Default SYM=2. Set SYM=1 for one period stabilization.--------------------------------------------endcommentINPUT U[1..3],I[1..3]DATA FREQ, SYMOUTPUT AP[1..3],APOWVAR APOW,power,pow[1..3], e[1..3],ap[1..3]DELAY CELLS (e[1..3]):(trunc(recip(FREQ*timestep*SYM))+1)HISTORY INTEGRAL(pow[1..3]) {DFLT:0}HISTORY e[1..3] {DFLT:0}EXEC  FOR n:=1 TO 3 DO      pow[n]:=U[n]*I[n]    e[n]:=INTEGRAL(pow[n])    IF t>=recip(FREQ*SYM)  -- Output after T/SYM    THEN        AP[n]:=(e[n]-delay(e[n],recip(FREQ*SYM),0))*FREQ*SYM    ELSE      AP[n]:=0    ENDIF  ENDFOR  power:=(pow[1]+pow[2]+pow[3])  --instantaneous active power  APOW:=AP[1]+AP[2]+AP[3]ENDEXECENDMODEL</datastring>
      </comp_content>
      <Model UseAs="WMeter" />
    </comp>

WRITEMONTECARLO.plantilla:
<comp Name="WRITEMONTECARLO" Id="WRITEMONTECARLO">
      <comp_content HighRes="false" Icon="default">
        <node Name="X" Value="" NumPhases="3" Kind="1" PosX="-20" PosY="0" NamePosX="-4" NamePosY="0" />
        <data Name="Resolution" Unit="#N" Value="100" />
        <data Name="Polarity" Unit="0;-1;+1" Value="0" />
        <data Name="Tlimit" Unit="s" Value="0" />
        <data Name="Withstand" Unit="kV" Value="650" />
        <data Name="Idx" Unit="Identifier" Value="1" />
        <datastring>MODEL WRITEMONTECARLO
comment--------------------------------------------------------
| Special purpose Model.                                      |
| The output of this Model is written to the lis-file.        |
| The data Idx is used to identify the module in the lis-file.|
| The lis-file is automatically read after the simulation.    |
| Handles multiple run.                                       |
| Plots the probability density of the signal                 | 
-----------------------------------------------------endcomment
INPUT X[1..3]
DATA 
  Resolution --Number of points in the plot
  Polarity   --0: No sign, -1: only negative, 1: only positive 
  Tlimit     --wait until this time to start looking for an extreme value.
  Withstand  --withstand voltage in kV. The model counts the number events above.
  Idx        --unique identifier (managed by ATPDraw)
VAR xout
INIT
  xout:=0
ENDINIT
EXEC
  if T>Tlimit
  then
    if Polarity > 0
    then
       xout:=max(xout,x[1],x[2],x[3])      
    elsif Polarity < 0
    then
      xout:=min(xout,x[1],x[2],x[3])
    else
      xout:=max(xout,abs(x[1]),abs(x[2]),abs(x[3]))
    endif
  endif
  if round(T/timestep)=round(stoptime/timestep)
  then 
    write('BEGIN WRITE @WRITEMONTECARLO',trunc(Idx)) --Do not modify this line, replaced by ATPDraw
    write(xout,' ', Polarity)                        --Add multiple columns or multiple lines 
    write('END WRITE @WRITEMONTECARLO',trunc(Idx))   --Do not modify this line, replaced by ATPDraw
  endif
ENDEXEC
ENDMODEL </datastring>
      </comp_content>
      <Model UseAs="WRITEMONTECA" />
    </comp>

\viewkind4\uc1\pard\lang1044\f0\fs20 MODEL WRITEPHASOR
\par comment-------------------------------------------------------------
\par | Special purpose Model. Writes the value of Xre and Xim @T=Tsampl.|
\par | The output of this Model is written to the lis-file.             |

\par ----------------------------------------------------------endcomment

\par   Idx     --unique identifier (managed by ATPDraw)
\par INPUT Xre[1..n],Xim[1..n] 
\par VAR i,written
\par INIT
\par   written:=0
\par ENDINIT
\par EXEC
\par   if (T>Tsampl) and (written=0)

\par     endfor 
\par     write('END WRITE @WRITEPHASOR', trunc(Idx))    --Do not modify this line, replaced by ATPDraw
\par     written:=1
\par   endif
\par ENDEXEC
\par ENDMODEL 
\par 
\par }
</helpstring>
        <datastring>MODEL WRITEPHASORcomment-------------------------------------------------------------| Special purpose Model. Writes the value of Xre and Xim @T=Tsampl.|| The output of this Model is written to the lis-file.             || The data Idx is used to identify the output in the lis-file.     |  | The lis-file is automatically read after the simulation.         || The result is displayes as phasors in the View dialog.           |----------------------------------------------------------endcommentDATA   n       --numbers of phases  Tsampl  --sample the values at this time  Idx     --unique identifier (managed by ATPDraw)INPUT Xre[1..n],Xim[1..n] VAR i,writtenINIT  written:=0ENDINITEXEC  if (T>Tsampl) and (written=0)  then    write('BEGIN WRITE @WRITEPHASOR', trunc(Idx))  --Do not modify this line, replaced by ATPDraw    for i:=1 to n do      write(xim[i],xre[i])                         --Add multiple lines    endfor     write('END WRITE @WRITEPHASOR', trunc(Idx))    --Do not modify this line, replaced by ATPDraw    written:=1  endifENDEXECENDMODEL </datastring>

<comp Name="WRITESCREEN" Id="WRITESCREEN">
      <comp_content HighRes="false" Icon="default">
        <node Name="X" Value="" Kind="1" PosX="-20" PosY="0" NamePosX="-4" NamePosY="0" />
        <data Name="Scale" Unit="Divide" Value="1" />
        <data Name="MaxOrMin" Unit="1/0; 1=Max" Value="1" />
        <data Name="TStart" Unit="s" Value="0" />
        <data Name="TStop" Unit="s" Value="100" />
        <data Name="Idx" Unit="" Value="0" />
        <datastring>MODEL WRITESCREEN
comment--------------------------------------------------------
| Special purpose Model.                                      |
| The output of this Model is written to the lis-file.        |
| The data Idx is used to identify the module in the lis-file.|
| The lis-file is automatically read after the simulation.    |
| Handles multiple run. If AsFuncOf is a number the           |
| simulation number is used instead.                          | 
-----------------------------------------------------endcomment
INPUT X
DATA 
  Scale --this can be an Variable. Used in the plotting x-axis
  MaxOrMin --if >0 the maximum with be stored, otherwise the minimum 
  Tstart   --wait until this time to start looking for an extreme value.
  Tstop    --stop looking for extreme value after this time
  Idx      --unique identifier (managed by ATPDraw)
VAR xmin,xmax,xout,out
INIT
  xout:=0
  xmin:=inf
  xmax:=-inf
  out:=true;
ENDINIT
EXEC
  if T>Tstart
  then
    xmin:=min(xmin,x)
    xmax:=max(xmax,x)
    if MaxOrMin>0
    then
      xout:=xmax
    else 
      xout:=xmin
    endif
  endif
  if out and ((T>=Tstop ) or (round(T/timestep)=round(stoptime/timestep)))
  then 
    write('BEGIN WRITE @WRITESCREEN',trunc(Idx))    --Do not modify this line, replaced by ATPDraw
    write(xout*recip(Scale))                        --Add multiple columns or multiple lines 
    write('END WRITE @WRITESCREEN',trunc(Idx))      --Do not modify this line, replaced by ATPDraw
    out:=false;  
  endif
ENDEXEC
ENDMODEL 
</datastring>
      </comp_content>
      <Model UseAs="WRITESCREEN" />
    </comp>
